tasks.name: 新删除指定向量
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== 删除从指定楼层起的 L1 / L0 向量 / L0 锚点（三项独立控制） ======
// 适配 LWB 3.1.5+：支持分别独立设置起始楼层，-1 表示跳过该项
(async () => {
    // ════════════════════ 修改这里 ════════════════════
    const L1_FROM_FLOOR        = 5006;  // 1. 从指定楼层删 L1（chunks 切片 + chunk 向量）；-1 跳过
    const L0_VEC_FROM_FLOOR    = 5006;  // 2. 从指定楼层删 L0 向量（只删 state 向量，保留锚点文本）；-1 跳过
    const L0_ANCHOR_FROM_FLOOR = -1;    // 3. 从指定楼层删 L0 锚点（atoms + l0Index，走原子注销并连带清对应向量）；-1 跳过
    // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════

    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const { chatId } = getContext();
    if (!chatId) {
        window.toastr?.error('❌ 未打开聊天');
        return;
    }

    const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';
    const [chunkStore, stateStore, summaryData] = await Promise.all([
        import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
        import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
        import(`${BASE}/data/store.js`),
    ]);

    // ── 统计前置数据 ──
    const metaBefore = await chunkStore.getMeta(chatId);
    const lastChunkFloorBefore = metaBefore?.lastChunkFloor ?? -1;
    const l1StatsBefore = await chunkStore.getStorageStats(chatId);
    const l0VecsBefore = await stateStore.getStateVectorsCount(chatId);
    const l0AtomsBefore = stateStore.getStateAtomsCount();

    const skipL1 = L1_FROM_FLOOR < 0;
    const skipL0Vec = L0_VEC_FROM_FLOOR < 0;
    const skipL0Anchor = L0_ANCHOR_FROM_FLOOR < 0;

    // ── 1. 删除 L1（chunks 切片 + chunk 向量） ──
    if (!skipL1) {
        await chunkStore.deleteChunksFromFloor(chatId, L1_FROM_FLOOR);
        if (L1_FROM_FLOOR <= lastChunkFloorBefore) {
            await chunkStore.updateMeta(chatId, { lastChunkFloor: L1_FROM_FLOOR - 1 });
        }
    }

    // ── 2. 删除 L0 锚点（atoms + l0Index） ──
    // 官方原子提交：会连带清理对应楼层的 state vectors
    if (!skipL0Anchor) {
        try {
            await summaryData.invalidateSummaryAnchors(chatId, L0_ANCHOR_FROM_FLOOR, 'manual_truncate');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[task] L0 锚点删除失败', error);
            window.toastr?.error(
                `❌ L0 锚点删除失败: ${error?.message || error}`,
                '数据删除', { timeOut: 8000 }
            );
            return;
        }
    }

    // ── 3. 删除 L0 向量（独立清除 state vectors） ──
    // 如果锚点已经删除了更早或相同的楼层，此处只需处理比锚点删除楼层更早的增量区间；
    // 如果未删锚点（skipL0Anchor=true），则在此精准删除 L0 向量并完整保留锚点文本
    if (!skipL0Vec) {
        const alreadyCovered = !skipL0Anchor && L0_ANCHOR_FROM_FLOOR <= L0_VEC_FROM_FLOOR;
        if (!alreadyCovered) {
            await stateStore.deleteStateVectorsFromFloor(chatId, L0_VEC_FROM_FLOOR);
        }
    }

    // ── 统计后置数据并输出 ──
    const l1StatsAfter = await chunkStore.getStorageStats(chatId);
    const l0VecsAfter = await stateStore.getStateVectorsCount(chatId);
    const l0AtomsAfter = stateStore.getStateAtomsCount();
    const lastChunkFloorAfter = skipL1 ? lastChunkFloorBefore : Math.min(L1_FROM_FLOOR - 1, lastChunkFloorBefore);

    const logMsg = [
        '========== [L0/L1 定点删除报告] ==========',
        `L1 (chunks+向量) 起始楼: ${skipL1 ? '跳过' : L1_FROM_FLOOR}`,
        `L0 向量           起始楼: ${skipL0Vec ? '跳过' : L0_VEC_FROM_FLOOR}`,
        `L0 锚点(文本/索引) 起始楼: ${skipL0Anchor ? '跳过' : L0_ANCHOR_FROM_FLOOR}`,
        '----------------------------------------',
        `L1 chunks       : ${l1StatsBefore.chunks} → ${l1StatsAfter.chunks}`,
        `L1 chunk vectors: ${l1StatsBefore.chunkVectors} → ${l1StatsAfter.chunkVectors}`,
        `L0 state vectors: ${l0VecsBefore} → ${l0VecsAfter}`,
        `L0 state atoms  : ${l0AtomsBefore} → ${l0AtomsAfter}`,
        `lastChunkFloor  : ${lastChunkFloorBefore} → ${lastChunkFloorAfter}`,
        '========================================',
    ].join('\n');

    console.info(logMsg);

    window.toastr?.success(
        `✅ 数据删除完成\n` +
        `L1 切片: ${l1StatsBefore.chunks} → ${l1StatsAfter.chunks}\n` +
        `L1 向量: ${l1StatsBefore.chunkVectors} → ${l1StatsAfter.chunkVectors}\n` +
        `L0 向量: ${l0VecsBefore} → ${l0VecsAfter}\n` +
        `L0 锚点: ${l0AtomsBefore} → ${l0AtomsAfter}`,
        'L0/L1 定点删除',
        { timeOut: 6000 }
    );
})();
<</taskjs>>
